answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Issuance tied to graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 9 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 980 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. History cannot be faked faster than the epochs themselves pass. What carries the velvet here is verification, the spiral of cost is what stops the farm, and the quartz of the record keeps every claim checkable. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
